user_prompt: I need to launch a new product campaign that coordinates with our vendors, validates compliance requirements, and ensures production is ready to fulfill orders. We're provisioning new customers across multiple regions, so we'll need to qualify vendors and manage the entire supply chain orchestration. As part of this rollout, we also need to track any product modifications we're making and manage the associated equipment and service requests that come with the deployment. Can you help us coordinate all of these moving parts together so nothing falls through the cracks?

1. sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1 — converts qualified opportunities to orders

- sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1 — reconciles invoices to POs

PRODUCT LIFECYCLE & MATERIALS TRACKING (siemens.plm, sap.s4):
- siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 — coordinates engineering changes across product items/materials, syncs config updates, tracks material lifecycle
- siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 — validates BOM against regulatory/supplier standards
- sap.s4:agent:AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator:v1 — coordinates engineering changes across materials & product items with asset provisioning
- sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1 — validates material specs & automates BOM updates

INCIDENT MGMT & EQUIPMENT (corp.itsm):

- corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1 — manages asset lifecycle provisioning; automates IT asset coordination following engineering changes; handles equipment allocation & provisioning workflows; capabilities: allocate-equipment, orchestrate-asset-provisioning, coordinate-equipment-assignment
- corp.itsm:agent:ChangeAutomationOrchestrator:v1 — automates change coordination across materials/product items
- corp.itsm:agent:IncidentSafetyCoordinator:v1 — manages safety incidents
- corp.itsm:agent:OccupationalSafetyIncidentCoordinator:v1 — manages occupational safety incidents

**CUSTOMER ACCOUNT IMPACT IDENTIFICATION** (sap.crm):
- sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1 — identifies affected customer accounts when engineering changes/material updates occur; processes product item modifications and automates notification workflows to affected accounts

**COMMUNICATION STRATEGY DEVELOPMENT** (emarsys.cx):
- emarsys.cx:agent:SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer:v1 — identifies high-value customer segments, optimizes campaign targeting/messaging, generates personalized messaging recommendations; works with affected customer accounts to develop communication strategy

1. Maintenance schedule review/coordination
2. Equipment documentation updates post-incident
3. Order fulfillment checkpoint tracking
4. Customer grievance/complaint handling
5. Customer billing dispute resolution
6. Accounts receivable management
7. Customer service management
8. Claims and resolutions documentation
